kb_knowledge.short_description: Legal Hold - Access Request Handling Runbook
kb_knowledge.text:
When an access request is received from a user who is under an active legal or litigation hold, DO NOT restore access. Confirm the hold via the security exception record and the account owner in Legal.

Required steps: 1) Ensure the account is disabled/frozen in every connected system (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack). 2) Move the Google Workspace account into the Legal Hold organizational unit. 3) Revoke all third-party OAuth tokens. 4) Force a credential reset. 5) Escalate the ticket to the Legal Hold Review group. 6) Put the ticket On Hold; do NOT resolve or close it as fixed. Preserve all data (never delete or deprovision) as required by the hold.
